meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用CLI创建、预览和渲染超帧动画与视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要开发超帧动画并用命令行管理渲染
copy.tagline_en: Create, preview, and render hyperframe animations and videos using the CLI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop hyperframe animations and manage rendering from the command line

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行执行 HyperFrames 视频工作流：初始化项目、检查错误、预览、渲染视频等。
howto.when: 当你说“帮我创建一个视频项目”、“检查这个视频项目的错误”或“渲染最终视频”时触发，也可诊断构建或渲染失败。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个视频项目，命名为测试。
say.note: Claude 会运行 init 命令创建项目。

say.text: 检查当前项目的 Lint 和 Check。
say.note: Claude 会执行 lint 和 check 命令。

say.text: 用高清质量渲染项目为 out.mp4。
say.note: Claude 会运行 render 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can execute the HyperFrames video workflow via CLI: init projects, check errors, preview, render videos, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "initialize a video project", "check errors in this project", or "render the final video", also when diagnosing build or render failures.

say_en.text: Initialize a video project named test.
Check lint and check for the current project.
say_en.note: Claude runs lint and check commands.

say_en.text: Render the project as out.mp4 at high quality.
